( Blinkers again ) Jumped Well , Went Forward led on rail x half length. Slight Advantage To The Turn . Joined on Straightening Up . Clear All The Way Straight Kept Trying No Match # led/sound
Jumped Fast Restrained Took sit 5th 1x1 2 1/2 Lengths enjoyed good trail To The Turn gone Straightening Up had all favours - # Quickly Beaten
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up Two Wide Outside Lead at 1100m, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , ran on hitting Lead 60m from post # solid win

Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (6L from lead). Stayed same until improving slowly on inside from 600m. Held up 3 Wide @ 450m & held up Four Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & raced tight @ 200m. Worked home OK in last 100m. # Margin unfair.
Jumped Well sat box seat 1 length off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little, kept on one pace # no excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 800m was steadied whilst awkwardly placed inside heels. Jockey reported that, under its large weight impost and in the heavy track conditions, his mount was unable to sprint strongly in the straight and laboured to the line. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, held up turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, kept on one pace with limited room, need to see again # inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rounding the home turn, when endeavouring to improve, was eased after making slight contact with another rnr. Stewards inquired into an incident  approaching the 100m where the gelding was steadied when crowded for room. Stewards were satisfied that no  rider had ridden carelessly and the matter was reported as a racing incident.
